help.text:
Tag Everyone Telegram Bot

Commands:
/in - Add yourself to a list
/out - Remove yourself from a list
/everyone - Mention everyone in the list
/all - Mention everyone in the list
/list - Show a list's members (without mention)
/createlist - Create a new list (admin)
/deletelist - Delete a list (admin)
/clearlist - Remove all members from a list (admin)
/help - Show this message
/status - Show the status of the bot

Triggers:
@everyone - Mention everyone in the list
@all - Mention everyone in the list

This project is open source and free to use.
Follow updates on News channel: @tageveryone_news

Developed by @Non_Sono_Matteo
https://matteosillitti.it

Source code: https://github.com/Matt0550/TagEveryoneTelegramBot
Buy me a coffee: https://buymeacoffee.com/Matt0550
